title: Bunny
author: Mona Awad
summary: Samantha is a scornful outsider in a university writing programme, until she is drawn into a clique of sugary women who call each other Bunny. Their invitation leads to rituals that get stranger and bloodier.
readIf: you like dark, satirical campus stories that slip from social comedy into surreal horror.
skipIf: you want a grounded plot, as it turns bizarre and ambiguous, and it has some graphic scenes.

pairings.reason: A classic of insular groups at a university where devotion turns deadly.
A short, strange novel about close women and a toxic bond, with an unreliable narrator.
A colder, sparer story of a woman whose behaviour disturbs everyone around her.
